notes.title: v1.6.2 patch notes
notes.content:
In this patch, we focused on improving a few things:
- Custom timer, you can now choose the time style you like to play in friendly challenge. You will have access to a few modes: None (no timer at all), fast (very limited time per turn and action), normal (same timer as in duel), long (time is doubled)
- Improvement of maintenance announcements. The maintenance popup was not extremely reliable, and you may have experiences a downtime 2 minutes after you started playing. The message announcing the maintenance will always be shown when you connect, telling you the time left before the upcoming maintenance.
- Fix: Level 4 of card upgrade was missing on some cards, now all of them should display properly. There is still a few cases (gorillion, strange barrel and some others) that may not show their 4th level OnDrag animation in the preview menu of the collection. We are planning a rework of this menu a bit later that should fix this.
- Fix: Daily orders not progressing. Sometimes some actions done early in the game was not considered achieved by your daily orders. That should now be fixed.

notes.title: Big Changes Coming to Mindbug Online
notes.content:
Hello fellow Earthlings,

Today, we’re announcing exciting updates to Mindbug Online! After listening to your feedback, we’ve made significant changes to enhance your experience, introduce a brand-new mode, and make the game more accessible.

[b]Duels will be Free-to-Play[/b]

We’re removing the restrictions on the Duel Queue! Previously, Duel Queue was limited to two games per day for free players, with AI Arena as the main free-to-play mode. However, we’ve heard loud and clear that this didn’t meet expectations for a competitive card battler. With this update, everyone has unlimited access to the Duel experience.

[b]Introducing the Colosseum: A weekly evolving Battleground[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44443552/61071b586e0fc7157d2541aa1db17ef01d90092b.png[/img]

While Duel Mode offers a competitive experience with a fixed meta over several weeks, the Colosseum introduces a fast-paced, ever-changing battlefield with unique card pools, global effects, and special rules that keep the gameplay fresh. In the Colosseum, players aim for 6 wins before 3 losses to earn a ticket to the final round. The format evolves weekly, featuring different card sets, exclusive new cards, and dynamic global effects. Players can earn exclusive rewards, including dedication, special cosmetics, and a weekly promo card for their collection.

You can find a full description of the new Colosseum Mode here: [url=https://mindbug.me/the-colosseum-evolving-battlegrounds/]Learn more about the Colosseum[/url]

[b]The Boxed Model: A Premium Experience[/b]

We still believe in the boxed model where purchasing the card set gives you full access to everything this set has to offer. This ensures a premium experience for those who want it.

[b]Here’s what premium players get:[/b]
[list]
[*]Unlimited Access to the Colosseum: Compete as often as you want in our weekly challenges ([url=https://mindbug.me/the-colosseum-evolving-battlegrounds/]learn more[/url]).
[*]Challenge a Friend: Directly invite your friends for a friendly match with this set.
[*]Progression Mode (Coming soon): Unlock 2 Mindbugs for the upcoming progression mode. ([url=https://mindbug.me/adventure-mode-a-sneak-peek-at-the-new-game-mode-arriving-early-2025/]learn more[/url])
[*]Organized Tournaments: Participate in qualifier tournaments for the World Championship, National Championships, and the Cup of Nations. The next tournament will happen soon. If you want to participate, you can [url=https://tourney.mindbug.me/tournament/241]register here[/url].
[*]Async Games (Coming soon): You’ll be able to enjoy games with your card sets at your own pace in the asynchronous game mode.
[/list]

[b]Why Are We Making These Changes?[/b]

Mindbug is our passion. We have been working day and night on this game for the last 3 years. We wouldn’t make these changes if we didn’t believe they would make Mindbug Online more accessible, engaging, and rewarding for everyone. Whether you’re a free player enjoying ranked matches or a premium player diving into the full spectrum of features, there’s something for everyone.

We truly appreciate your feedback and passion for Mindbug. Your voices are shaping this game into something special, and we can’t wait for you to dive into Duels, explore the Colosseum, and experience all the exciting updates that will come next.

We understand that this is a significant change to our monetization model. If you feel that this new direction no longer aligns with your expectations and you’ve already purchased a set, you’re welcome to contact us (via info[at]kissaki.de). We want to ensure that all our players feel valued and supported during this transition. However, we firmly believe that owning a full card set is now more valuable than ever!

Stay tuned for more updates, and we’ll see you in the Colosseum!

The Mindbug Team

notes.title: The Launch of Mindbug Online
notes.content:
After three years of dedicated development, Mindbug Online is set to release on November 13th. This marks an incredible journey for us—a small indie team working with boundless passion and commitment to bring this game to life. Supported in part by funding from the German state and the federal state of North Rhine-Westphalia, some of our team members have had the chance to work part-time on the project. But like many indie developers, we’re balancing day jobs and family commitments, often diving into this work during evenings, weekends, and even late nights.
From the outset, we had a vision of a feature-rich app, an ideal version that would fully showcase the potential of Mindbug. However, as a small team with limited resources, we also have to be realistic and limit our scope to what is achievable. That said, we’re proud of what we’re delivering on day one. The scope of the release includes a suite of features designed to provide an immersive, competitive, and enjoyable experience for players. 

[h1]Here’s what you can expect from the launch:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Duel Mode: Engage in competitive, thrilling PvP matches with matchmaking and a carefully designed league system. Our card rotation mechanic will keep the metagame fresh and challenging.
[*] AI Arena: A highly developed AI arena featuring 100 difficulty levels for players to hone their skills and test strategies.
[*] Mindbug Reward Paths: Two distinct paths packed with tutorials, legendary quests, and puzzles, allowing players to explore the game’s depth at their own pace.
[*] Cosmetics: A broad range of visual effects and animations that add flair to every match, including foil and parallax effects, animations, sounds, and arena-specific cosmetics like unique Mindbug models, player avatars, emojis, and card backs.
[*] Achievements: A fully integrated achievement system to help players track progress and celebrate milestones.
[/list]

These features make for an engaging first experience, but this is only the beginning for Mindbug Online. We’re deeply committed to expanding the game and have a host of exciting updates and features planned for the near future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44443552/d067eec0ec6860ecff00ef17353d726c22587c8d.png[/img]

[h1]What’s Next for Mindbug Online?[/h1]
We want Mindbug Online to continue evolving alongside our community. Here’s what’s on our roadmap, and we can’t wait to work with you, our players, to bring these additions to life:

[list]
[*] Progression Mode: A PvP roguelite game mode with deck-building elements that will give players a continuous sense of challenge and strategy.
[*] Tournament Mode: In-app tournament features that will work in tandem with our organized play program, which includes the World Championship, National Championships, and a Nations Cup.
[*] New Achievements: To provide even more ways for players to track and showcase their progress.
[*] Events: We’re planning to experiment with exciting new game modes as special events—think ultra-fast matches, draft and semi-constructed formats, and many more.
[*] New Set Releases: Fresh card sets will be introduced every few months to keep the gameplay dynamic and exciting.
[/list]

We’re grateful for the enthusiasm, support, and feedback we’ve already received from our community. Will the app be bug-free on day one? Probably not. Will it include every feature we’ve dreamed of? Definitely not. But we hope you’ll join us on this journey to make Mindbug Online the best it can be. For us, this isn’t a one-time launch; it’s the beginning of a long-term adventure. With your support, we can continue to grow the game and bring our vision to life.

notes.title: Our demo is live !
notes.content:
From Monday 14th to 21st of October, come and try our latest Demo.

Here the modes we made available for this Demo:
1. Tutorial: New to the game ? that's where your start to understand the basic concept of the game
2. Duel: Want to face others players in fast and intense matches ? That the perfect place to be !
3. Friend Challenge: Invite your friends to the demo, add them as a friend and you can start duelling with them.
4. Puzzles: Not scared of challenges ? Then you should definitively try our puzzles. The more you progress through them, the more difficult they will became.
